name: Madison County, VA
findings: Madison County has 49 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Madison County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Madison County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
